LBR.note: Operator and USAID backbone project; no government rural programme or rural/urban use figures stated.

facts.fact: CSquared, USAID and Digital Invest committed to building a 350 km backbone crossing 13+ towns in Margibi, Bong and Nimba counties and connecting Monrovia to the Ivory Coast and Guinea borders, partly on Liberia Electricity Corporation utility infrastructure.
CSquared describes the 350 km backbone as Liberia's first open-access fibre backbone, providing high-capacity long-distance transmission services to Liberian telecommunication operators.

LBR.note: Only a ranking by A4AI (95th of 100), no gap figure.
Cross-border links to neighbours described as enabled by the backbone, but no route stated in service carrying international traffic.
Only a 22% penetration rate for early 2022 from Global Data Insights, outside the window and not an ITU or survey figure.
